name: led-bar
prompt: Build a 5 V indicator bar: six LEDs in a row, each with its own series resistor, all driven from a pin header so an external board can switch them. Power comes in on screw terminals.
notes: Repetition and fan-out. Six independent legs plus a wide pin header exercise the router more than the design; `led_no_series_resistor` fires per LED if the agent economises.
